title: NightAir Playlist
notes: Ben Taylor and his brother supplied the CDs. The printed labels name Ben Taylor, St Anne’s.
Ben described the rank as a rough guide: AA first, then A to D. Presenters were to tick each track they used so the same music did not turn up every day. AA and A tracks could be repeated.

The track order, spellings, versions, timings, and CD references follow the 1995 list. The Word table retains punctuation lost in the comma-separated text file. Parentheses in a CD number distinguish references inside the same numbered slot.
CD titles follow the printed labels, which cover 99 of the 100 numbers. Each number appears in the track list.
